description: Embalses is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by mapas-gis-inter.carm.es. This layer shows the reservoirs of interest for the Region of Murcia. Within the regional territory we find 15 reservoirs: Alfonso XIII, Algeciras, Almadenes, Argos, Azud de Ojós, Carcabo, Cierva, Jewish, Mayés, Pliego, Puentes, Romeral, Santomera and Valdeinfierno and, outside the Region of Murcia, the Cenajo reservoir is located, of great importance for the regulation ... Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Reservoirs" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 3 download or service links in WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
